{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final verification: load data and compute
# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define the population: new customers reached by paid search
mask_new_paid_search = (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')

count_new_paid_search = mask_new_paid_search.sum()
converted_count = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_count / count_new_paid_search

# Confirm no issues
assert count_new_paid_search > 0, "No 'new' customers in 'paid_search' channel"
assert df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "'converted' contains non-binary values"
assert (df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'status'] == 'refunded').sum() == 0 or df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'converted'].sum() == df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'converted'].sum(), "Refunded orders are incorrectly counted as converted"

# Final result
print(f"Count of new customers in paid_search: {count_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Converted count: {converted_count}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
